prerequisites: A collector config for the local diagnosis session
Instrumented services exporting to the local collector endpoint
rollback: Stop the local collector and exporters
Discard captured traces/spans from the diagnosis session

hosts.notes: Telemetry evidence supports distributed diagnosis and telemetry claims; it can never substitute product acceptance.

notes: telemetry_only=true: PASS from telemetry evidence alone is never product acceptance.
Activation requires a claim naming telemetry/diagnosis; an observability claim does not activate browser or mobile providers.
